description: Save a durable SELF-REPORT of a prediction-market evaluation for a decision that did not open a position. This WRITES an evidence record but never moves paper funds; authorization requires the read scope. It does not independently verify your evaluation. Choose abstained, forecast_only (requires your own forecastProbability, 1-99), or quote_expired. Report once per decision cycle; cohort.universeSize records its breadth. Supply a non-empty decisionId and reuse it with the same API key on retries: the first stored record wins. agentTrace.decisionId is a fallback; omitting both creates separate records. Success returns body.decisionUuid and, on replay, body.idempotentReplay=true. Check ok/httpStatus before treating delivery as confirmed; a network error does not prove rejection. Use open_pm_position to place a paper trade.

agentTrace.description: Optional private trace metadata stored in the caller's ledger.

decisionId.description: Agent decision id for quote/write attribution.

rationaleSummary.description: Optional concise rationale summary. Do not include chain-of-thought, secrets, or account identity.

strategyLabel.description: Short strategy label, self-reported by the caller.

universeSize.description: How many markets you were choosing from this cycle.

decisionId.description: Non-empty id for this decision, unique within your API key. Reuse for retries. Falls back to agentTrace.decisionId; omitting both creates a new record on each call.

forecastProbability.description: Your OWN forecast probability (1-99). REQUIRED for forecast_only; optional for other kinds. Never echo the market price.

kind.description: abstained = evaluated but did not bet; forecast_only = formed your own probability without trading (forecastProbability required); quote_expired = a validated open the server rejected at act time.

marketProbability.description: The market price (0-100) you observed at the time.

outcomeExternalMarketId.description: Optional case-sensitive outcome/market id of the subject.

provenance.description: Optional self-reported provenance (WHAT RAN). No trust: the server stamps policy versions + providerVerified itself. Any block (even {}) makes the artifact schemaVersion 2.

configHash.description: sha256 hex of your resolved config/spec. HASH ONLY — never raw text.

evidenceRef.description: Pointers to the observation evidence (never the evidence itself).

promptHash.description: sha256 hex of your exact prompt strings. HASH ONLY — never raw text.

runtimeKind.description: The runtime surface you ran on (self-reported; no trust).

runId.description: Your own run id for grouping.

source.description: Optional subject market source slug (e.g. kalshi).

name: report_pm_opportunity

body.description: Parsed CoinRithm response body, or raw text when the response is not JSON.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status returned by CoinRithm, or 0 for network errors.

ledgerEventId.description: Private AgentActionEvent id returned by /api/agent/*, when present.

ledgerStatus.description: Ledger write status header returned by CoinRithm, when present.

ok.description: True when CoinRithm returned a successful 2xx response.

title: Report a non-opened PM opportunity
